_comment: Guided tour for the ALEX Creator. Targets are the names the app registers for its controls; a step with an await waits until the user operates that control (the tour never presses it).

steps.title: Load a photon file
steps.text: ALEX alternates excitation lasers within the macro-time. Loading detects measured phase candidates automatically at the configured Period and Shift; review them before assigning laser identities. Press Open… and choose a TTTR file (a .sm, .ptu, .ht3 ...), or drop one on the window. Its folded ALEX phase appears as a histogram.

steps.title: Measure the period
steps.text: Press Detect period to measure the alternation period from the photons themselves: the two busiest detectors alternate, and the strongest line of that alternation sets Period. A stream that does not alternate is refused with its contrast and Period stays as it was. The histogram and the excitation regions fold again at the measured period.

steps.title: Set the period and the shift
steps.text: Period is the alternation period in macro-time units (not seconds) and Shift moves the phase. Type a value and press Enter, or use the arrows or the mouse wheel over a field: the histogram on the right folds again at once. Set them to the known instrument period and phase. Re-detect updates all excitation-region candidates; inspect Start/End, transition warnings and detector groups before confirming Review. Regions are overlays and do not filter photons.

steps.title: Define the excitation ranges
steps.text: Each row is one excitation phase found in the folded histogram and drawn as a shaded band. Double-click Start or End to define a range by hand (Start above End wraps across phase zero), and tick Review once checked. Re-detect replaces your edits with the measured ranges. Regions never filter the exported photons.

steps.title: Write the converted file
steps.text: Save as… writes a new photon file whose micro-time is the folded ALEX phase, in the output container chosen under Output (Formats). The input file is never overwritten. The button stays grey until a file is loaded.

await.hint: Press Save as… (Cancel in the dialog to skip writing).

steps.title: Queue files for a batch
steps.text: For many files, Add files… (or Folder…, or the session database) fills the queue below. The period, shift and formats above apply to every file in it; select a row and press Remove (or Delete) to drop one.

await.hint: Press Add files… (Cancel in the dialog to skip).

steps.title: Convert each, or merge
steps.text: Choose Convert each (needs an output folder) or Merge into one (successive streams are joined with continuing macro-time before folding), then press Run batch. The written file names appear above the histogram.
